items.title: Bioenergetics aur ATP: cells ki tawanai ki currency (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the chapter opening and the ATP section, printed pages 140-141.

blocks.text: Har jandar (living organism), sab se chhote bacterium se le kar sab se bari whale tak, tawanai (energy) se chalta hai. Yahi tawanai us ke barhne (growth), nasal barhane (reproduction) aur rozana zinda rehne ke kaam aati hai, is liye tawanai zindagi ki bunyad hai. Lekin yeh tawanai aati kahan se hai? Cells ise kaise hasil kar ke zindagi ke beshumar kaamon mein istemal karte hain? Is ka jawab bioenergetics ke dilchasp shoba (field) mein hai.

Bioenergetics is baat ka mutala (study) hai ke zinda nizamon (living systems) mein tawanai kaise behti hai. Is mein un amal (processes) ko parha jata hai jin se cells tawanai jama (store) aur kharch karte hain. Photosynthesis aur respiration (tanaffus) ke amal bioenergetics ke kuch usool samajhne mein madad dete hain: photosynthesis tawanai pakarne wala amal hai, jabke respiration tawanai chhorne (release karne) wala amal hai.

blocks.title: Tawanai kahan se aati hai
blocks.text: Zameen par jandaron ki istemal hone wali taqreeban tamam tawanai photosynthesis se aati hai. Poday, algae aur kuch bacteria sooraj ki roshni pakar kar use chemical tawanai mein badalte hain; yahi food chain ki bunyad hai.
